title: End-window readout has no owned next action and broad re-ask returns
simulated_faults: A readout records no-change or rerun-narrower but does not assign an owner action or recheck date.
The next owner ask repeats the same broad export instead of trimming decision-neutral fields.
The dispatch leaves public language and lifecycle posture ambiguous after the readout.

expected_blocks.expected_failure: Every readout disposition must produce an owned post-readout context receipt reroute gate with allowed/prohibited next actions and a recheck date.
The next evidence ask must re-ask only decision-bearing aggregate fields and drop raw traces, protected facts, small cells, security payloads, and vendor outcome summaries.
